snippet.title: HELLFIRE: HOWL OR WEEP UPDATE - TRAILER
snippet.description: Are you ready for a... HARDMODE!! That's right, torture yourself with stricter time limmits, higher point goals and also a very cranked up bossfight (you'll see wink wink) in the next update for Hellfire, releasing October 30th!
